propositions: test_full_backend_account_is_present fails deterministically on hosts with scc or lizard installed on PATH because the test lacks explicit metric-tool fixture control
the test asserts a metric coverage record without controlling optional metric-tool availability, causing the below-threshold fixture to emit no metric match and omit the backend from reconstruction

the sibling test test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already forces _METRIC_CANDIDATES to a missing binary to ensure host-independence, but test_full_backend_account_is_present missed this same control
the fix adds explicit missing-metric-tool fixture control to test_full_backend_account_is_present to make it deterministic and assert the expected skipped/no_tool coverage record
production grounding behavior and evidence schema remain unchanged; no metric match record is emitted when a tool runs but finds no threshold-exceeding results
